lock.confirmation_seeds: Original untouched predeclared 20461010+1000*scenario+rep, test+1000000; all 90 original A0-A4 datasets
lock.selection_reason: Predeclared priority alpha2/scale0 retained: highest development Exact28/90, over-selection9/90 versus23/90, 6/9 scenario PMSE reductions and 2 strong n400 scenarios unchanged10/10. Other rules have lower mean PMSE but more under-selection; candidate is not best mean PMSE and does not outperform A0/A2 mean PMSE. Research confirmation, not formal adoption. No confirmation output examined.
lock.fresh_refit_requirement: All three fresh complete A3 searches must pass frozen-pool/default/locked-model/input-test/OLS equivalence before confirmation starts. No old candidate cache.

lock_timing.scope: Lock precedes earliest saved worker-log mtime; controller separately enforces lock before launching any confirmation fit
